notes.title: The fee system will change from March 1, 2024.
notes.content:
[h1]Purchase watermark removal from within the app[/h1]
Until now, the system was to purchase from the Steam store,
From now on, you will be able to make purchases within the app.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40754418/6ad75cd2c07cbb7ce9e711095f37bc447f5251c1.gif[/img]

*The video is under development.

In the Steam Store, the notation will change to "Free".
Anyone can get the app, but a watermark will appear until you make an in-app purchase.
The behavior before in-app purchases is the same as the previous demo version.

[h1]Prices are based on Japanese yen or US dollars[/h1]

The monthly fee is 410 JPY or 3.99 USD.
For other currencies, the price will be based on the current exchange rate of USD 3.99.

[h1]New price plan[/h1]
We are planning to offer discounts for annual contracts in the future.

Also, since it will be "free" within the Steam store, there will no longer be any Steam sales.
Instead, we are planning to run a discount campaign at [url=https://twitter.com/TwilightWings_]X Account[/url].

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
The current Demo version will be deleted and will no longer be accessible.

----------

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your continued patronage.

notes.title: ver.1.5.0 Net Collab + VC, Transparent Texture, Virtual Webcam with Transparency
notes.content:
Announcement of New Features:

We are excited to inform you about the following new features in this release:

[list]
[*] Transparent Texture Support
[*] Virtual Webcam with Transparency Support
[*] Net Collaboration + Voice Chat
[/list]

[h1]Transparent Texture Support[/h1]
We are thrilled to introduce the ability to use transparent textures! By enabling this feature in the "settings," you can immediately take advantage of it. Now you can wear semi-transparent clothes, adding a touch of elegance and style that was previously unachievable.  Upgrade now and elevate your fashion with our latest release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40754418/c2949a27a5532f5c8efc7b1b770cecb651996a89.png[/img]

[h1]Virtual Webcam with Transparency Support[/h1]
With the introduction of transparent texture support, we have updated the virtual webcam to enable transparent video output.
To use this feature, please go to the "settings" screen and click on "start" again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40754418/272053e08cfd6987fbb7a80af4b3130d0a9fe398.png[/img]

For improved output quality, we recommend using a black background instead of blue or green backdrops for the background image.
In OBS, please set as follows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40754418/392ea33564ff7818f5cb29b56d693de68fd03b0d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Net Collaboration + Voice Chat[/h1]
We are thrilled to finally release our network feature, now equipped with voice chat for added convenience! With the transparent virtual webcam, you can avoid accidental visibility issues caused by green or blue backgrounds obscuring your partner's appearance.

Furthermore, thanks to lip-syncing with your partner's voice, collaborations become even more enjoyable and realistic in real-time.

Upgrade now and experience the enhanced network functionality with voice chat, making collaborations more seamless and fun!

[h1]Known Issue[/h1]
Depending on NVIDIA settings, the frame rate may not be controlled, resulting in improper functioning of the application. To resolve this, please configure NVIDIA VSync to wait or try the following settings in the "settings" menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40754418/6fa9a53ab494d810e4ff8baf0da64f65e9ef3861.png[/img]

The above is an example with FPS fixed at 60 frames.

notes.title: ver.1.1.0 Made it possible to link with VRoid Hub
notes.content:
[h1] You can now work with VRoid Hub! [/h1]
From ver.1.1.0, it can be linked with [url = https: //hub.vroid.com/] VRoidHub [/url].
VRoid Hub is a service that allows you to share VRoid with other VRoid users and link it with apps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40754418/4a99969fd01744508f7b88db51d0edf5889b5591.jpg[/img]

[h1] What is VRoid Hub? [/h1]
VRoid Hub is a platform to upload (human) 3D model data created with software such as [url = https: //store.steampowered.com/app/1486350/VRoid_Studio_v0140/]VRoid Studio[/url]. Characters registered to VRoid Hub can be imported and used as avatars on other VR/AR platforms and 3D contents by using the dedicated SDK.

After a 3D character is uploaded to VRoid Hub, an individual profile page will be created for that character. There, users can browse the character's name, various social media and other information. If the creator allows it, the model data can also be downloaded.

The model data on VRoid Hub can be used with various 3D services such as VR/AR platforms supporting that model data of the VRM format and games created with Unity.

[h1] What this application can do in conjunction with VRoid Hub [/h1]
You will be able to use the model registered in VRoid Hub directly. I have accessed and enabled the VRoid Hub model on our application.

[h1] To use the VRoid Hub model [/h1]
You need to access VRoid Hub and register as a user in advance. Also, at first, only the model you registered on the application or the model picked up by the VRoid Hub staff will be displayed. Also, models that are offensive to public order and morals will not be displayed.

For other models, the models that have been hearted model on VRoid Hub will be displayed, so first of all, please put a "heart" to a lot of models you like in VRoidHub. Doing so will also display many available models in your application.

https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/en-us/articles/360014089474-How-to-use-characters-on-connected-apps

[h1] Attention[/h1]
There are many models registered on VRoid Hub using software other than VRoid Studio.
Therefore, since some data is not recognized by this application, it may not be possible to apply the eye transparency shader or facial expression change parameters. Please note.

[h1]List of models available in the app[/h1]
https://hub.vroid.com/apps/CkMVyywhG5vnNC1woMY1WHqwcx0eUR6nb6Pwavmtmqs/character_models

notes.title: Detailed method for you who want to use NarikiriVTuber with livestreaming !
notes.content:
[h1]How to use?[/h1]
We will briefly explain to you who want to use it for livestreaming.
let's solve it one by one!

Start Narikiri VTuber.

Select a VRM file...

[h1]Wait a minute, what is a VRM file?[/h1]
"VRM" is a file format dedicated to humanoid avatars of 3D models, and the extension is ".vrm". It was announced in April 2018 by Dwango Co., Ltd., which operates the video sharing service Nico Nico Douga, and has been released as open source since then.

[b]In short, it's a "virtual doll"![/b]

VRM files will be available for various services in the future, so it may be a good idea to create one yourself at this opportunity.

[h1]How to create a VRM file?[/h1]
It's a good idea to use [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486350/]VRoid Studio[/url], which is also available for free on Steam.
You can easily create your own avatar!

[h1]I want to get a VRM file quickly![/h1]
The following avatars are available for free and royalty-free!
Check [url=https://creativecommons.org/share-your-work/public-domain/cc0]CC0[/url] for a detailed license.
You may find other avatars of your choice on VRoidHub!

[url=https://hub.vroid.com/characters/675572020956181239/models/4479743608263344465]AvatarSample_D[/url]
[url=https://hub.vroid.com/characters/945152946522067123/models/3383751442912063017]AvatarSample_E[/url]
[url=https://hub.vroid.com/characters/6193066630030526355/models/3525604181073039892]AvatarSample_F[/url]

[h1]Once again[/h1]
Once you have the VRM file ready,
select your vrm file from NarikiriVTuber and select "Go to Scene" to start it.

In this state, use the webcam to change the angle of your face to the angle of the avatar's face.
From the voice of the microphone to the movement of the avatar's mouth, to laughing and smiling
And if you have Leap Motion, you can move your hands to some extent.

[h1]I want to livestream ![/h1]
This is a commonly used [url=https://obsproject.com/]OBS[/url] usage method.
Use window capture from source.
Let's select NarikiriVTuber here.

If nothing is done, the blue background will be visible.
Right-click on the window capture and select "Filter".
Select the chroma key from the "+" button at the bottom left. The name can be "Chroma key" as it is.
The chroma key settings will appear, so select "Custom" as the color key.
Select "# 0000FF" from the color selection.
Adjust the similarity to around 255.

If you are using an avatar that uses a blue color, press "Change Background Color" from the NarikiriVTuber menu to make it a green background.
This will prevent the blue part of your avatar from disappearing.
All you have to do is change the setting to "# 00FF00" by selecting the color of the chroma key.

Finally, the menus of VTuber are in the way, so press the "Space key" to hide the menu.
If you need the menu again, press the spacebar again to redisplay it.

Now you can view your avatar with just a few tweaks to your usual delivery!
Have a fun VTuber life!
